title: Austin Taiwanese Association 奧斯丁 台灣同鄉會
content_html: The Austin Taiwanese Association (ATA) is a regional chapter of the Taiwanese Association of America (TAA, 全美台灣同鄉會), the national umbrella organization for Taiwanese American community associations in the United States. The chapter serves the Taiwanese American community in the Austin, Texas area and is listed under the TAA Southern (美南) regional division.
